rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=7e-05, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0008, wu_sigmoid_slope=4.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-18 (one knob vs iter-17 best). NUMBERS: sigmoid_slope 10->0.30880(iter-11), 6->0.30888(iter-17 marginal BEST, +8e-5). Shallower band roll-off helps a hair. FAILURE MODE: at the ultra-low-param ceiling ~0.309; gains now sub-1e-3 (noise-floor territory). ONE KNOB: wu_sigmoid_slope 6.0 -> 4.0 (INIT, NO param change, 12 params). HYPOTHESIS: if slope=4 gives hr > 0.30888 the shallow-roll-off trend continues and I adopt it; if hr < 0.30888 the slope optimum is near 6 and the method has fully plateaued at hr~0.309 (12 params) -- consistent with the known ultra-low-param ceiling. Budget: ~735s.
